summary_zh.motivation: 建立考虑激光穿透深度的SLM有限元仿真模型

summary_en.motivation: To develop a finite element simulation of the selective laser melting process that accounts for the optical penetration depth of the laser into the powder bed.
summary_en.method: A coupled thermomechanical finite element model with temperature-dependent powder properties was implemented.
summary_en.result: Melt pool dimensions and thermal history were predicted and showed good agreement with single-track experiments.
summary_en.validation: Numerical results were validated against experimental single-track scans from literature.
